# UPSENSE (PT UPSENSE Teknologi Indonesia)

> Perusahaan pengembangan software custom, ERP, HRIS, aplikasi web dan mobile, serta layanan transformasi digital untuk perusahaan di Indonesia. Berkantor di Jakarta Utara.

## Facts

- Legal name: PT UPSENSE Teknologi Indonesia
- Brand: UPSENSE
- Website: https://upsense.co.id
- Address: Wisma SMR, Jl. Yos Sudarso Lt 9, Unit 904, RT.10/RW.11, Sunter Jaya, Kec. Tj. Priok, Jakarta Utara, DKI Jakarta 14350, Indonesia
- Phone/WhatsApp (Sales): +62 852 1700 0041
- Email (Sales): sales@upsense.co.id
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ejfkCLspwKYMNZDL8
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/upsense.id/
- LinkedIn: https://id.linkedin.com/company/pt-upsense-teknologi-indonesia

## Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://upsense.co.id/services/layanan-customisasi-software-bisnis/): ERP, CRM, HRIS, warehouse, workflow automation, dan integrasi sistem yang mengikuti proses bisnis.
- [Website Development](https://upsense.co.id/services/layanan-pengembangan-website/): Pengembangan website perusahaan dan platform web yang terintegrasi dengan proses bisnis.
- [Mobile App Development](https://upsense.co.id/services/layanan-pembuatan-aplikasi-mobile/): Aplikasi Android, iOS, dan cross-platform untuk pelanggan maupun operasional internal.
- [Software Development](https://upsense.co.id/services/software-development/): Solusi custom software untuk digitalisasi enterprise dan modernisasi workflow.
- [Web Development](https://upsense.co.id/services/web-development/): Platform web responsif dan sistem digital terhubung.
- [Odoo ERP Customization](https://upsense.co.id/services/odoo-erp-customization/): Implementasi dan penyesuaian Odoo untuk finance dan warehouse.
- [HRIS & Mobile Attendance](https://upsense.co.id/services/core-hris-mobile-attendance/): Sistem HR, absensi mobile, shift, leave, approval, dan data payroll-ready.
- [Learning Management System](https://upsense.co.id/services/learning-management-system/): Platform pembelajaran digital untuk organisasi.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://upsense.co.id/services/cloud-devops/): Migrasi cloud, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring.
- [Analytics Solutions](https://upsense.co.id/services/analytic-solutions/): Dashboard interaktif, predictive analytics, integrasi data, custom reports.
- [Product Design](https://upsense.co.id/services/product-design/): Desain produk digital berbasis riset pengguna.
- [App Design](https://upsense.co.id/services/app-design/): Desain UI/UX aplikasi mobile.
